notes: Check short replies to a buyer concern and reusable response libraries. Distinguish both from competitive fit analysis and broader conversation scripts. Apply full-deliverable checks only when that deliverable was requested. Definitions are not executed results.

should_trigger.prompt: Please build a structured objection handling library from qualified objection evidence, with response patterns, proof, and escalation rules.
Please create or improve reusable objection handling by segment, stage, persona, or competitor context.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable objection library and label anything that still needs confirmation.
My buyer says a competitor is 30% cheaper. I've got a call shortly. Help me respond naturally without inventing proof or offering a discount.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please analyze a defined set of sales calls or notes and produce an evidence-backed objection brief by segment, persona, or stage.
Please review one sales call and turn recording, transcript, or notes evidence into clear coaching priorities and next-practice actions.
Please build and refine value propositions and messaging frameworks for revenue teams.
Help me assess where we fit against Competitor X for a plant-floor evaluation. I need the requirements that favour each offer and when we should qualify out, not a reply to an objection.
Write a 30-second opener for our next product demo. We have agreed the agenda and want to confirm the buyer's priority before showing anything.

output_structure_checks.name: objection-library-builder-core-output
output_structure_checks.description: For a library, returns source-grounded play cards with diagnosis, response, proof status, and escalation. For an imminent conversation, gives a usable question and supported spoken response without requiring the library workflow.

output_structure_checks.name: objection-library-builder-decision-discipline
output_structure_checks.description: Makes the requested decision or next action explicit while separating verified evidence, provisional assumptions, conflicts, and decision-critical unknowns.

output_structure_checks.name: objection-library-builder-practitioner-fit
output_structure_checks.description: Treats buyer-reported competitor pricing as unverified, makes no unsupported superiority or savings claim, and offers no concession beyond supplied authority.

task_scenarios.prompt: I've got a call in 30 minutes. Our buyer said: Competitor X is 30% cheaper, so I don't see why we'd pay more. We're selling scheduling software to an operations team. That's all I know about their quote. Our verified capability is routing work between teams with an audit history. I have no approved savings numbers and can't offer a discount. Help me answer them naturally. I don't need a whole playbook.

assertions.name: objection-library-builder-urgent-price-response-1
assertions.description: Provides a neutral diagnostic question, a short supported spoken response, and a next move that follows from the buyer's answer. Establishes relevance before treating a verified capability as a reason to choose.

assertions.name: objection-library-builder-urgent-price-response-2
assertions.description: Does not treat the 30% report as a verified like-for-like comparison, claim unsupported differentiation or savings, or offer a discount.

assertions.name: objection-library-builder-urgent-price-response-3
assertions.description: Keeps turns short enough to say aloud and does not require company-context setup or a reusable library.
